jobs.title: Sr./Staff Product Designer, Growth
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

We're looking for a Product Designer to own the surfaces where Runway turns usage into revenue: pricing, upgrade paths, checkout, and the moments a creator decides Runway is worth paying more for. You'll partner with growth engineering, product, and data to turn goals like ARR growth, expansion revenue, and reduced churn into tested, shipped design changes.

What you’ll do

  • Own growth-critical surfaces (pricing pages, paywalls, upgrade prompts, and checkout flows) from concept through shipped, tested experiments

  • Turn business goals like ARR growth, expansion revenue, and reduced churn into design hypotheses and interface changes you can test

  • Design and read A/B tests and other experiments with growth engineering and data, iterating fast on what moves the numbers

  • Collaborate closely with growth engineering and product to ship experiments quickly and turn winners into permanent product surfaces

  • Contribute to visual and interaction consistency between growth surfaces and the rest of the product

  • Set the design direction for Runway's growth surfaces and mentor other designers working in the funnel

What you’ll need

  • Experience designing product surfaces tied directly to revenue and can point to what moved ARR, conversion, or expansion revenue in a past role

  • Comfort running and reading quantitative experiments, not just shipping a single "best" design

  • Experience designing flows, prototypes and high-fidelity UI's for web products, with strong visual design skills

  • Experience delivering and iterating fast in close collaboration with engineering, and product teams

  • Ability and flexibility to iterate fast and often

  • Comfortable picking up unfamiliar parts of the product rather than waiting to be assigned only what you already know

  • Knowledge and understanding of the creative tool space

  • Bonus points if you have experience creating functional prototypes using AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.)

  • At Runway, it's always a bonus if you have artistic and creative potential (particularly skills with video/audio editing, icon/typography design, illustration, etc.)

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

Working at Runway

Great things come from great teams. We’d love to hear from you.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. So regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply.

More about Runway

  • Universal World Simulator

  • GWM-1

  • Gen-4.5

  • General World Models

  • Robotics SDK

  • Conversational Real-time Agents

  • Runway Studios

We're excited to be recognized as a best place to work:

Crain's | InHerSight | BuiltIn NYC | INC

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Backend Engineer, API
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

We're looking for an API engineer to join our core API team and help scale Runway's platform serving millions of users and handling thousands of requests per second. You'll work on the critical infrastructure that powers both our public API (used by external developers) and internal tools, managing user data, task orchestration, billing, permissions, and asset management.

This is a high-impact role on a mature, production system. You'll build enterprise features, optimize database performance, design async workflows, and ensure reliability at scale. If you're passionate about API development, love TypeScript, and want to own systems end-to-end, this is the role for you.

A peek at our technical stack

Our API endpoints for real-time collaboration and media asset management is written in TypeScript, and runs in ECS containers on AWS Fargate. We leverage multiple AWS-native components, such as S3, CloudFront, Lambda, Kinesis, and SQS, as building blocks of our infrastructure.

Our inference backend is written in Python (PyTorch, TorchScript), and is deployed across multiple clusters / cloud providers. We use Kubernetes for container orchestration, and k8s-native components such as Flyte, Kueue, and Kyverno efficient job orchestration. We invest in prometheus and grafana for monitoring, and Terraform to manage our infrastructure.

What you’ll do

  • Own the full API lifecycle from design and implementation to monitoring, optimization, and documentation for both public and internal APIs

  • Design and implement async workflows for task orchestration, content moderation, prompt enhancement, and post-processing pipelines

  • Optimize database queries and improve performance for a high-traffic Postgres database

  • Build rate limiting, fraud detection, and credit management systems

  • Implement comprehensive API security, rate limiting, authentication, and monitoring systems to ensure reliability at scale

  • Improve the public API developer experience with better documentation, SDKs, and tooling

  • Improve the performance, reliability, and code quality of our codebases

What you’ll need

  • 3+ years of industry experience building production APIs

  • Strong TypeScript experience, so you can jump in and be productive immediately

  • Experience owning systems end-to-end: infrastructure, monitoring, logging, metrics, incident response

  • Understanding of API design patterns, REST principles, and async workflows

  • Experience with relational databases (Postgres preferred) and query optimization

  • Experience architecting production-ready systems at scale using cloud primitives from AWS, GCP, or Azure

  • Ability to rapidly prototype solutions and iterate on them with tight product deadlines

  • Humility and open mindedness; at Runway we love to learn from one another

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

Working at Runway

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. So regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

Building general world models — systems that understand and simulate reality across tasks, modalities, and domains — demands training data that is as rich and varied as the real world itself. We’re looking for Research Engineers to own the data behind our models: what they learn from, how well they learn it, and what new capabilities that unlocks. You will design datasets, run modeling experiments, and build the infrastructure to generate and curate data at scale — directly shaping what our models can do, with applications ranging from creative tools to robotics.

What you'll do

  • Design multimodal, multitask datasets that teach world models new capabilities — deciding what data to collect, generate, or curate and measuring its effect on model behavior

  • Run controlled training experiments to understand how data composition drives model performance across tasks and domains

  • Build and operate large-scale pipelines for synthetic data generation, filtering, and quality control

  • Define evaluations and benchmarks that measure whether our models are actually improving at the things that matter

  • Partner with product and creative teams to translate target behaviors and capabilities into concrete data strategies

What you'll need

  • 4+ years of experience in machine learning, bonus points for data-centric approaches

  • Experience with large multimodal datasets and generative models (video, image, or multimodal)

  • Deep intuition for how data composition and quality translate to model capabilities

  • Comfort working across the full research stack: data analysis, dataset creation, model training, evaluation, and back again

  • Proficiency with at least one ML framework (e.g. PyTorch, JAX) and distributed compute tools (e.g. Ray, Kubernetes)

  • Excitement about building AI that simulates the world

  • Operate as a strategic thought partner internally: codifying the use cases we know work today while pioneering the ones that don't exist yet, and translating both into initiatives that shape Runway's product strategy and industry positioning

  • Identify and prototype specific and highly targeted new markets and new opportunities for our products

  • Develop a deep, functional and technical understanding of our products and future roadmap

  • Be hands-on in quickly onboarding new partners to our platform and/or API while also supporting their long-term expansion and technical understanding of how to leverage Runway

  • Provide high-impact feedback to Product, Engineering, and Creative which can in turn improve the product experience for our partners

  • Analyze, track, and report on the performance of existing partnerships leveraging BI tools and data

  • 5+ years of overall experience in customer-facing roles, engaging C-level technical audiences with complex global organizations ideally within tech, finance, or consulting

  • Have led complex implementations of Generative AI/traditional ML solutions and can drive measurable business outcomes

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities with expansive ownership and ruthlessly prioritize

  • A strong bias towards action and belief that no task is too small for you

  • Have a track record of rapidly prototyping ideas and a willingness to work iteratively with your customers to deliver the right solution that solves their problem

  • Possess exceptional presentation and communication skills, particularly when engaging with executives and leaders

  • High technical aptitude for understanding complex technologies, tools, systems, and issues

  • Mindset to think creatively and think beyond past checklists and playbooks

  • Highly resourceful with the ability to create structure and work autonomously amidst ambiguity

  • Nice to have but not required: experience with data tooling and BI systems (SQL, BigQuery, Retool, etc)

  • New York, SF, or London-based preferred

jobs.title: Enterprise/Sr. Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Open to hiring remote across North America - NYC, San Francisco, or Denver preferred.

You will carry a book of 10-30 accounts - $1B to $5B+ revenue companies. You work in a pod with a dedicated Enterprise Engagement Manager on a shared book: one account plan, shared customer outcomes, and comp designed to maximize earnings and customer value.

This is a role that requires a depth of expertise selling to Fortune 500 companies, knowing how to architect multi-disciplinary commercial deals, comfort regularly selling to C-Suite executives, and strategic GTM deal architecture.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Run 10-30 concurrent enterprise cycles a year at $100K - $1M+, from first outbound through production deployment

  • Build multi-threaded relationships across creative, marketing, technology, and procurement in $5B+ organizations

  • Win new logos in whitespace and source expansion in existing accounts

  • Work your pod plan with your Engagement Manager so consumption milestones land quickly

  • Forecast with the discipline of someone the CRO plans around: staged exits, named next steps, no happy ears

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 5+ years of enterprise software sales with consistent six and seven-figure deals

  • A quota history above 100% you can walk through year by year, President's Club achievement, etc.

  • Demonstrated account development: you have grown named accounts 2-3x, and renewals were the floor of that growth

  • Command of MEDDPICC or equivalent, with the CRM hygiene to prove your pipeline is real

  • Working AI fluency - you use generative tools yourself and can demo credibly to a skeptical enterprise buyer

STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO HAVE

  • Sold creative or content technology

  • Sold consumption or usage-based contracts

  • Sourced the majority of your own pipeline

COMPENSATION

OTE $275K - $340K (50/50 base to variable). Offers equity.

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

Working at Runway

Great things come from great teams. We’d love to hear from you.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. So regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role 

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the team responsible for Runway's product platform and API. You should have experience growing high-performing engineering teams and be deeply interested in the intersection of product development, APIs, and distributed systems. You will will manage our current and growing team of 5.

You’ll have a chance to work closely with our product engineering, product management, and finance teams to build low-latency, high-reliability APIs for our AI-powered creation tools as well as the infrastructure to support them.

A peek at our technical stack

Our API endpoints for real-time collaboration and media asset management is written in TypeScript, and runs in ECS containers on AWS Fargate. We leverage multiple AWS-native components, such as S3, CloudFront, Lambda, Kinesis, and SQS, as building blocks of our infrastructure.

Our inference backend is written in Python (PyTorch, TorchScript), and is deployed across multiple clusters / cloud providers. We use Kubernetes for container orchestration, and k8s-native components such as Flyte, Kueue, and Kyverno efficient job orchestration. We invest in prometheus and grafana for monitoring, and Terraform to manage our infrastructure.

What you’ll do 

  • Drive platform strategy and architecture for our TypeScript-based API infrastructure, ensuring code quality, maintainability, and scalability as we grow

  • Own the public API domain end-to-end, from technical architecture to revenue growth, ensuring it's a high-quality, revenue-generating platform that developers love

  • Manage our data and analytics infrastructure, ensuring data integrity, security, and accessibility for teams across the company

  • Lead and grow a team of 4-6 platform engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement

  • Partner with Product Engineering teams to unblock new feature launches, providing platform support and ensuring smooth integration between frontend experiences and backend capabilities

  • Own critical data pipelines and metrics that power business decisions across Finance (cost-of-sales, revenue attribution), Support (usage analytics, error tracking), and Product (feature adoption, performance metrics)

  • Work cross-functionally with leadership to set priorities, communicate progress, and align platform investments with business goals

What you’ll need

  • 2+ years of experience in an engineering manager or team lead role, with a track record of building and scaling high-performing teams

  • 5+ years of hands-on engineering experience, with specific expertise operating TypeScript services in the cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure)

  • Strong product sensibility and business acumen – you understand how technical decisions impact revenue, customer satisfaction, and company metrics

  • Experience owning revenue-generating platforms or products, with an understanding of API economics, usage-based pricing, and developer experience

  • Solid foundation in data engineering and analytics, including experience with metrics pipelines, data modeling, and business intelligence tooling

  • Database expertise, particularly in managing production databases at scale, data migrations, and ensuring data integrity

  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills – you can translate technical concepts for business teams, explain business constraints to engineers, and build consensus across diverse stakeholders

  • Comfort with ambiguity and rapid iteration – you can make smart trade-offs between perfect and good-enough in a fast-moving startup environment

  • Empathetic and inclusive leadership style that empowers engineers to do their best work

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

Working at Runway

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. So regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

About the role

We’re looking for Research Engineers to contribute to our ambitious research agenda spanning multimodal foundational models, interactive world modeling, and real-time generation. This role is highly collaborative and will touch many aspects of our broader research efforts, taking a full-stack approach across pretraining, SFT/RL post-training techniques, evaluation, and bringing models to production.

What you’ll do

  • Run experiments to teach world models new behaviors — action following, scene manipulation, camera control, and beyond

  • Develop and test new data strategies, architectural variants, and training techniques

  • Design evaluations that measure model capabilities, and use them to drive model improvement

  • Take features from research prototype to production, collaborating with product and creative teams to address application-specific gaps

  • Contribute across the entire stack (data pipelines, modeling, production inference) to move projects forward

What you’ll need

  • 4+ years of experience in machine learning research or engineering

  • Familiarity with the architecture, training, and inference of large-scale multimodal generative models

  • Experience building robust data pipelines for pretraining and post-training

  • Comfort working across the full research stack: data, training, evaluation, and deployment

  • Proficiency with at least one ML framework (e.g. PyTorch, JAX) and experience with distributed training at scale

  • Ability to context-switch quickly and drive projects forward in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment

  • Excitement about building AI that simulates the world

You'll explore new interfaces and interaction paradigms for AI generated video, world models, and agentic systems helping translate cutting-edge research into tangible, usable experiences.

This role requires a blend of design skills and technical expertise, along with a genuine passion for both. As part of a small team, you’ll collaborate with researchers, engineers, and product designers to develop concept prototypes, design high-value interactive features, and build tools that enable new creative and research workflows.

What you’ll do

  • Prototype and implement novel user experiences at the intersection of AI video, world models, and emerging generative media

  • Design and build agentic tools and interfaces that allow researchers and creatives to interact with and direct AI systems in real time

  • Explore new application areas for AI video and general world models — from simulation and interactive media to research tooling

  • Stretch the limits of front-end engineering to broaden what’s possible in research and experimentation contexts

  • Create internal tools and frameworks used across design and engineering teams at Runway Labs

  • Work alongside researchers, engineers, and product designers to shape how we think about the future of AI-driven creativity

What you’ll need

  • Genuine curiosity about AI video, world models, agentic engineering and generative media and an intuition for how to design meaningful interactions with these systems

  • Experience designing flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity UIs for web and agentic products

  • Experience building agentic tools or interfaces — i.e., systems where AI takes actions, reasons over state, or drives multi-step workflows

  • Strong understanding of visual and interaction design, as well as usability testing

  • Comfort working in ambiguous, research oriented environments where the problem space is still being defined

About the role

*Open to hiring remote across the US — preferable to have someone near an office in NYC or San Francisco.

This is a rare PM role with true vertical ownership across the full product lifecycle; from early-stage research and pre-training through to post-training and UX buildout through to GTM strategy and pricing - giving the right person a GM-like mandate to drive product decisions end-to-end in a way that's unique for a company of our scale.

We’re looking for a passionate Product Manager to help us develop cutting-edge AI tools. This role is for someone who has a combination of strong technical or ML background and experience in product management. You have the ability to take the state-of-the-art AI systems our research team builds and turn them into impactful tools for our customers.

You’ll deeply understand what users want, what’s possible to build, and what’s strategic for our business. You’ll be a bridge between our users and our internal teams so we ship products that have the most value for Runway’s creators.

This role is a fundamental and critical part of the team for a market-defining company in its early stages.

What you’ll do

  • Work alongside our research team to define new AI applications that solve customer needs and drive business value

  • Collaborate closely with engineering and design to productize research and continuously improve existing tools

  • Define and analyze metrics, talk with users weekly, and conduct A/B tests to discover use cases, validate pain points, and prioritize features

What you’ll need

  • 1+ years of direct experience with SQL, python, code generation tools, and version control best practices

  • 4+ years of product management experience

  • Familiarity with the current state-of-the-art ML capabilities and ML products

  • Experience working with fast-moving teams and building products from scratch

  • Passion for seeing research through from initial conception to ultimate application

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

About the role

*Open to hiring remote across the west coast — we also have offices in San Francisco and Seattle

We're building a tool that makes content creation accessible for everyone, from individual creators to Fortune 500 enterprises. We're looking for people who are deeply versed in the Runway product and can take a strategic and creative view to Enterprise Support. If that's you, read on!

What you’ll do

  • Manage customer inquiries across email, chat, Slack, focusing on complex cases requiring human judgment

  • Provide technical and creative support to enterprise customers via written communication and calls

  • Investigate technical issues and create detailed bug reports that save engineering time

  • QA test AI support automation for quality and accuracy

  • Partner with Customer Success on enterprise implementation and adoption, and collaborate cross-functionally with Product and Engineering teams

  • Stay current on product updates by actively using Runway

  • Contribute to knowledge base, documentation, and process improvements

  • Identify systemic issues from ticket patterns and calls, and proactively suggest improvements and operate autonomously - you know when to escalate vs. own a problem through resolution

What you’ll need

  • Experience with a mix of video editing, content creation, creative workflows, or generative AI tools

  • 3-5+ years in customer-facing technical roles (support, solutions engineering, CSM, technical account management)

  • Proven track record handling enterprise customers and complex escalations

  • History of working autonomously with minimal supervision

  • Examples of process improvements or systems you've built

  • Highlight and explain common use cases and workflows for Enterprise organizations

  • Serve as the day-to-day product expert for both pre and post sales conversations; help businesses understand the potential of utilizing Runway in their creative pipeline

  • Be a champion for our customers and work with our internal teams to translate customer feedback into product insights; liaise between customers and our internal teams in order to provide the best support and experience possible

What you’ll need

  • Full professional bilingual fluency in Japanese and English

  • Experience & expertise creating content from end to end

  • Experience working with Japanese enterprises a plus

  • Passion for experimentation when it comes to content creation and creative workflows- you care more about “how we get there” than “the destination”

  • You love sharing and presenting the things you’ve built

  • Ability to deliver complex information to customers in a clear and concise way

  • Ability to thrive in a constantly changing and growing environment

  • Excitement about AI and motivation to continuously learn more about this new and exciting space!

About the role

We're looking for a Product Designer to own the experience developers have building on Runway's API: the docs, the console, and the moment someone goes from reading a reference page to a working integration. You'll partner with platform engineering and product to turn a fast-moving API surface into something developers can actually pick up and use.

What you’ll do

  • Design the developer console and API docs experience, from account setup and API keys to usage, billing, and rate limits

  • Prototype and ship playground tools, quickstarts, and code samples that let developers test endpoints and outputs before writing integration code

  • Turn new models and endpoints into clear, well-documented interfaces as the platform ships, keeping pace with a fast-moving API surface

  • Collaborate closely with platform engineering to design authentication, webhooks, and other technical flows in terms developers actually understand

  • Contribute to visual and interaction consistency between the developer platform and the rest of Runway's product

  • Set the design direction for the developer platform as a whole and mentor other designers working on it

What you’ll need

  • Experience designing developer-facing products with a platform or tool you've shipped to point to

  • Comfort translating technical concepts into interfaces a developer can use without reading a manual first

  • Experience designing flows, prototypes and high-fidelity UI's for web products, with strong visual design skills

  • Experience delivering and iterating fast in close collaboration with engineering teams

  • Ability and flexibility to iterate fast and often

  • Passion for working with small teams, establishing a design culture, and creating a design-centric process within the company

  • Knowledge of the creative tool space and genuine interest in how developers build with generative AI

  • Experience in creating functional prototypes using AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.)

  • At Runway, it's always a bonus if you have artistic and creative potential (particularly skills with video/audio editing, icon/typography design, illustration, etc.)

We are seeking a visionary and high-impact General Manager for Japan to lead our commercial expansion. This is a foundational role. You will be responsible for defining our go-to-market strategy in Japan, establishing enterprise partnerships and customer relationships and driving the adoption of Runway’s creator platform across the region.

Note: For candidates based in Tokyo, this role may expand into the Country Manager, overseeing local operations and serving as the primary representative of Runway in Japan.

What You'll Do

  • Lead commercial efforts by designing the go-to-market strategy for Japan, focusing on high-value enterprise accounts in media, entertainment, advertising, brands and technology sectors

  • Identify enterprise and distribution partnerships, cultivating relationships with C-suite executives at Japan’s largest firms, navigating the unique nuances of Japanese business culture and long-term relationship building

  • Localize product and marketing strategy to the Japan market, working closely with Product, Creative, and Marketing teams to ensure Runway’s offerings and messaging are deeply resonant with Japanese customer base

  • Serve as the subject matter expert on the Japanese and broader Asia competitive landscape, regulatory environment and emerging AI trends

  • Build the Japan office by recruiting, leading and mentoring a local team of enterprise account executives, and growth and deployment leads

  • Represent Runway at major industry events, conferences, and in the media to establish us as the leading AI partner for Japanese creators and enterprises

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise software, media technology or high-growth AI startups, with a proven leadership track record of building and cultivating high performance teams

  • Native fluency in Japanese, with professional fluency in English. You must be able to bridge the communication gap between our US teams and local stakeholders

Join the frontier of shaping generative AI video and its legal landscape as an early lawyer at Runway. We are looking to hire a Commercial Counsel who has a strong background in B2B SaaS customer negotiations. Other nice-to-have experience includes: legal operations, privacy, and strategic IP-heavy partnerships, and product counseling. You are a self-starter who thrives at getting things done in fast-paced, unstructured environments. You have a passion for helping companies build and bringing scalable initiatives across our commercial and other legal workstreams.

While the role is in large part focused on the commercial legal function, you might also bring to the table generalist experience across domains such as data privacy, vendor negotiations, and compliance. You will serve as a strategic thought partner to cross-functional teams from sales to partnerships to marketing and to the Runway Executive Team. Comfort working within a highly technical, rapidly evolving area of the law is a must.

What you’ll do

  • Lead negotiations with Runway’s customers and strategic partners. These include B2B SaaS customer contracts for our generative AI SaaS platform and APIs, DPAs, partnership agreements, and vendor agreements.

  • Implement commercial processes, tools, and infrastructure to help us scale, including improving templates, playbooks, contract review automation, and our legal tech stack

  • Empower the sales team with tools and knowledge to close deals quickly

  • Dive into the technical aspects of our generative AI products to learn them inside and out, to inform your advice to the business

  • Closely follow technical, legal, and policy developments in the generative AI space

What you’ll need

  • A J.D. and admission in good standing with at least one state bar

  • 3+ years of negotiating complex technology transactions, including 1+ years negotiating B2B SAAS customer contracts on a commercial legal team at a fast-paced late stage private or mid-sized public B2B SaaS company

  • In addition to B2B SaaS customer contract negotiations, experience with data privacy, legal operations, strategic IP-heavy partnerships and preferably B2C legal issues are nice-to-have

  • Bias for action and a willingness to take ownership

  • Growth mindset that prioritizes continuous operational improvement and service excellence

  • Experience with scaling business processes globally and operating in environments that have achieved significant scale

  • Excitement about generative AI and motivation to continuously learn more about the legal landscape governing a new and exciting industry

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

*Open to hiring remote across North America. We have offices in NYC, San Francisco, and Seattle.

We’re looking for an AI-Native Social Media Creative, a creative generalist who works natively with AI tools to produce exceptional short-form work for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and X. Your background might be in editing, directing, design, animation, art direction or writing. What matters is that you’re already deeply embedded in AI-assisted creative workflows and are pushing the boundaries of what these tools can do. Editing is the core of the role, and you know how to cut short-form video that holds attention from the first frame to the last.

This is a making role. You’ll create work across formats, from short-form video and motion to design and editorial, using Runway’s products and the broader landscape of generative AI tools. Some days you’ll be cutting a launch-day Reel from generated footage. Other days you’ll be jumping on a trend the moment it breaks, building out tutorial content or exploring a creative application of a product feature no one’s tried yet. The output varies; the throughput and quality standard don’t.

Much of your work will sit at the top of the funnel, often as someone’s first encounter with Runway. It needs to stop the scroll, perform with the algorithm and feel native to each platform. You’ll also work in real time, turning model releases, trends and cultural moments into fast, reactive content while they’re still peaking.

You’ll sit within the creative department and report to the Social Media Lead. But the nature of the role means you’ll also work across product, research and marketing, often as the person who translates a product capability into a compelling creative artifact that’s geared to social audiences.

 

What you’ll do

  • Create high-quality short-form video, motion, design and animation for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and X using AI tools, primarily Runway’s own products

  • Edit short-form content built to hold attention, from the opening hook through the final frame

  • Develop concepts and execute finished work, not just prototypes, from initial idea through final output

  • Create top-of-funnel content that stops the scroll and performs with each platform’s algorithm

  • Respond to trends, news and cultural moments with fast, real-time content

  • Explore and push the creative boundaries of generative AI tools, finding new techniques, workflows and visual languages

  • Produce content across brand campaigns, product marketing, social, tutorials and internal demos

  • Partner with product and research teams to translate new features and model capabilities into creative work that showcases what’s possible

  • Contribute to the team’s evolving creative process by sharing workflows, techniques and best practices as the tools themselves evolve

What you’ll need

  • 4 to 8 years of professional creative experience in social, in editing, directing, design, animation, art direction, writing or a combination

  • Exceptional short-form editing skills, with a strong instinct for hooks, pacing and sound

  • A portfolio that demonstrates exceptional creative output made with AI tools, not just traditional work, and not just experimentation, but polished, intentional creative work

  • Deep, hands-on fluency with generative AI creative tools: you use them daily and understand their capabilities and constraints at a practitioner level

  • Strong visual and conceptual taste: you know what good looks like regardless of the medium or how it was made

  • Proven understanding of social media across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and X, with a strong handle on trends, formats, strategies and what each algorithm rewards

  • Real-time instincts: you spot trends early and turn quality work around fast

  • Self-direction and creative initiative: you don’t wait for a brief to start making

  • Curiosity about the technology itself: you follow model releases, experiment with new tools and understand the trajectory of generative AI

  • Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where the tools, workflows and possibilities are changing constantly

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

*Open to candidates based near our NYC office or those willing to relocate.

Building general world models — systems that understand and simulate reality across tasks, modalities, and domains — requires closing the loop between learned representations and real-world action. We're looking for a Robotics Engineer to bring our video-native foundation models onto real hardware: deploying world-model-based policies on real robots and making them work in the real world.

You will work across the full stack of robot learning — from data collection and task design, to policy deployment, to physical evaluation. This is a hands-on, execution-oriented role at the intersection of foundation models, learned robot policies, and hardware. You'll bring deep robotics domain expertise and help us ship world-model-based robot policies end-to-end, with applications ranging from manipulation to mobile robotics.

What you’ll do

  • Own the deployment loop for learned policies (VLAs, diffusion policies, World Action Models) on real robot arms: inference serving, action decoding, controller integration, latency budgets, and safety limits

  • Diagnose real-world policy failures — determining whether the problem is data coverage, camera/proprioception mismatch, or execution — and partner with the research team to fix it at the right layer

  • Design demonstration data collection protocols (task setup, camera placement, teleop conventions) that produce data our world models can actually learn from — working with our existing teleop and lab infrastructure

  • Partner with research to run controlled experiments connecting world model representations, data composition, and fine-tuning recipes to physical success rates

  • Define and run physical evaluation protocols so results are trustworthy and comparable across policy iterations

  • Adapt our policy recipe to partner hardware and new embodiments

What you’ll need

  • You have personally deployed software on real robot hardware and iterated to make it work — whether learned policies, motion planning, classical control, or perception-driven manipulation. You can walk through a specific system you shipped, what broke on the physical robot that didn't break in sim or testing, and how you fixed it.

  • Fluency in the software-to-robot interface: action/command spaces, control frequencies, observation pipelines, calibration, and how each affects real-world behavior

  • Comfort working at the intersection of software and physical systems: you can reconfigure a robot workspace and trace a policy failure in the same afternoon

  • Bonus: direct experience deploying learned policies (VLAs, diffusion policies) on real hardware; experience with video/multimodal generative models or world models

Runway Enterprise is a complete solution for enterprises, offering out-of-the-box creative tools, a generative media developer platform, model licensing, and forward-deployed creatives and researchers that embed directly within enterprises.

We're hiring an Enterprise product marketing leader for Runway Enterprise, leading the segment and developing priority verticals including Media, Retail/eCommerce, Software, and more.

This is not a purely positioning or “launch” role. You'll own the success of the enterprise segment, partnering closely with the sales & enablement team, enterprise marketing & growth. You’ll lead the development of Runway’s overall enterprise messaging and positioning and create tailored, vertical-specific messages and value propositions, built from your first-hand experiences engaging directly with Runway’s customers.

This is a builder's role. You'll be defining the discipline, working shoulder-to-shoulder with sales, product, creative, marketing and growth; you'll be measured on the growth of the business (not just on assets shipped or messaging consistency).

What You'll Do

  • Own the Enterprise segment. Define Runway audiences in the enterprise: who they are, the jobs they hire Runway for, how they differ across verticals. Ground audiences in hands on customer research, win/loss details, and usage analysis. Turn these insights into a point of view that product and leadership actually build against.

  • Own positioning and messaging for enterprise & vertical solutions. Define how Runway is positioned across its audiences, with tight value propositions and proof points for key verticals. You’ll make the story sharp, consistent, and reflective of Runway's ambitious brand, and make sure a professional buyer recognizes themselves in it.

  • Drive acquisition and conversion, not just awareness. Partner with growth to move the funnel that matters for this segment: acquisition channels and targeting that find more customers within our ICPs. You're comfortable owning metrics and running experiments, not just producing the narrative around them.

  • Drive competitive intelligence and response. Track and deeply understand the key players across the AI creative tools market. Turn your market understanding into a living point of view on where we win, where we're exposed, and how we respond, and make it legible to product and leadership.

  • Partner on enablement. Partner with the sales enablement team to develop assets that drive confidence in Runway’s customers and sellers alike.

  • Player & coach. You’ll operate hands on as the direct owner of Enterprise and Solutions Marketing; opportunity to lead and manage a team of PMMs for candidates of the right seniority.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in product marketing, including time leading PMM for a winning enterprise product at meaningful scale. You’ll bring a track record of work that moved business metrics and grew new verticals (not just launches & messaging that you shipped).

  • Core & Vertical expertise. You’re comfortable leading product positioning exercises at the executive level. You come with a proven track record of industry/vertical product marketing, including defining, developing, and launching new verticals.

  • Exceptional positioning and narrative craft. You can take research concepts and technical products and make them land for a discerning, professional audience. You create sharp positioning, ad creative, and launch stories (and you can write them yourself).

  • You thrive in an environment with rapid pace and a high accountability culture. You move very fast, make decisions with incomplete information, and instinctively gravitate toward shipping today (not writing docs for tomorrow).

  • Sharp competitive instincts. You track markets closely, form a real point of view on where to win, and translate it into product and messaging decisions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You confidently assess the state of the business, call out challenges, and articulate your plans to solve them.

  • (Bonus) Pricing and packaging experience. You've shaped how a product is packaged and priced across individual and team/enterprise tiers, and you understand the tradeoffs a self-serve-to-enterprise motion creates.

  • (Bonus) PLG. You've led product marketing efforts in a growth stage company with both PLG & Sales Led motions.

Runway Creative is an all-in-one platform giving creators and businesses endless ways to generate and edit video, images, and audio. Our user base spans across professional creatives, as well as business owners and enterprise marketing and merchandising teams that come to Runway to generate videos, ads and other content to promote their products and services.

We're hiring for a Senior Product Manager to build agent products. You’ll own new product development end-to-end, from customer and technical discovery, to product shaping and viability, to quality and feedback loops that make these products better. You’ll work at the frontier of agentic product development, shaping how Runway Agents help our customers grow their businesses.

What you’ll do

  • Represent the customer: develop deep understanding of creative and marketing workflows through frequent customer engagement; synthesize findings on agent performance and behavior, and lead a team with clarity and conviction.

  • Lead Agent Development: run user interviews, competitive research, eval analysis, and prompt experimentation. Shape your findings into new product offerings that solve customer problems in new and novel ways.

  • Own agent quality: create eval infrastructure, monitor regressions, and ensure that agents improves with every release.

  • Shape the scope: scope ruthlessly to deliver exceptional user value on a fast paced release.

  • Ship, hands-on. ship your own PRs to improve the product experience. You'll be in the details daily and shipping regularly.

  • Create compelling launch moments: enable sales, support, and marketing with the context they need to communicate new agent capabilities effectively

What you’ll need

  • 8+ years in the software industry, with direct ownership of an AI or LLM powered product in a product management or engineering leadership role. A track record of moving revenue and adoption metrics, not just shipping features.

  • You thrive in an environment with rapid pace and a high accountability culture. You move very fast, make decisions with incomplete information, and instinctively gravitate towards shipping today, not writing docs for tomorrow.

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping agent-products - you understand tool use, planning loops, multi-step reasoning, and how and why agents fail. You have deep familiarity with prompt engineering and evaluation frameworks.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You can make a sharp, written argument and tell a compelling launch story. You confidently assess the state of the business, call out challenges and articulate your plans to solve them.

jobs.title: VP/Director, Enterprise Revenue
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Open to hiring remote across North America - NYC, San Francisco, or Denver preferred.

Runway is scaling its Enterprise revenue organization with leaders who know how to build and scale high-performance teams. And, who can operate a revenue machine while keeping customer value in mind - leading our industry-based revenue pods responsible for both net-new ACV, NRR, and Renewal.

This role is designed for the leader who wants to accelerate their CRO career trajectory. Someone who knows how to build and scale teams and leadership excellence from $100M to $500M+ organizations, operate in AI-native fluid environments, and have experience selling-to, expanding, and renewing with client operators from across a variety of ICPs (From operators in Marketing, HR, Operations, and Finance, to technologists in AI, IT Infrastructure, and Security).

Runway is searching for leaders who enjoy the build - hiring top-performing AEs and frontline leaders to grow your teams for scale. You’re a leader-of-leaders who lead hybrid revenue pods of AEs + Engagement managers. We expect you to think like a CRO - every pod is effectively a P&L, expansion is as much your number as new logos, and any customer who signs needs to see value through consumption of the Runway platform.

If you have only ever inherited a running enterprise org, this is not the right fit. If you have built one, we'd like to talk.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and lead an Enterprise segment of 3-4 frontline sales managers; each with 3-5 revenue pods beneath them with operating Enterprise Account Executives and Engagement Managers in each pod. At scale, this role leads 25 - 40 GTM teammates

  • Own the segment's new ACV and NRR targets - both numbers, one owner, reviewed weekly with the CRO

  • Engage personally with C-level executives on accounts, building business cases and navigating procurement, security review, legal through to production deployment

  • Run the operating rhythm: forecasting to +/-5%, deal inspection, pipeline generation discipline, and account planning across a long-cycle book

  • Ensure that each of your leaders engages their revenue pods (AE + Engagement manager) to drive license consumption and value output. The more we invest in our customer’s adoption, the more everyone wins.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 12+ years of enterprise software sales with 5+ years leading enterprise sales organizations with experience as a second-line leader

  • A validated record of building - you have grown an enterprise segment past 25 sellers and beaten the number while doing it

  • Personal history of closing and sponsoring $250k-$1M+ ACV deals with $1B+ revenue companies

  • Experience running consumption or usage-based revenue models, where expansion is earned through customer value

  • Fluency with modern AI - you use these tools daily, operate your team with them to drive productivity, you can demo Runway credibly to a CMO or CTO, and you have a defensible point of view on where generative media is going

  • Deep understanding of MEDDPICC and Command of the Message to reinforce value-orientation and deal progression with your teams

  • A record of exceeding quota year-over-year

STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO HAVE

  • Experience selling API and AI infrastructure solutions to CTO / CIOs

  • Sold creative, media, or content technology to Fortune 500 marketing and studio organizations

  • Built vertical pod or team structures with shared new ACV + NRR%/Renewal ownership

  • Scaled a GTM org through the $100M to $500M+ revenue stage

COMPENSATION

OTE $400K - 475K (60/40 base to variable). Offers equity.

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

Working at Runway

Great things come from great teams. We’d love to hear from you.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. So regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply.

More about Runway

  • Universal World Simulator

  • GWM-1

  • Gen-4.5

  • General World Models

  • Robotics SDK

  • Conversational Real-time Agents

  • Runway Studios

We're excited to be recognized as a best place to work:

Crain's | InHerSight | BuiltIn NYC | INC

We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

Why this matters

Runway is building AI to simulate the world. We think world models, not language models alone, are the path to general-purpose simulation: systems that experience the world, learn from their mistakes, and change how stories get told, how science gets done, and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Applied AI is where that research meets a customer with a deadline. Every one of the world's largest studios, brands, and platforms hits a moment where Runway stops being a demo and becomes the way they actually make things. Our team exists for that moment, and we organize around one question: what's blocking this customer from production, and how do we remove it?

About the role

This is a role for people who want to own a problem, not an account. You'll sit with the biggest studios, brands, and Fortune 100 companies in the world, figure out what's actually standing between them and production, and build whatever removes it. Some weeks that's a workflow. Some weeks it's a plugin or an integration nobody has written yet. Some weeks it's getting a room of executives to make a decision they've been putting off.

Your work will be on screen: Emmy-winning shows, Oscar-winning films, Super Bowl commercials, the stuff people actually watch. And the things you build for one customer tend to become product for all of them. Our team's first Shopify plugin started as a customer blocker and was in engineering's hands within a few weeks. We treat this team as R&D for that reason, not as a cost center.

We have offices in NYC, San Francisco, Seattle, and London.

No two weeks are the same, but you can expect to:

  • Find the real problem: sit with the creative, technical, and executive teams at a customer, map how they actually work, and locate the blocker between them and production. Usually it's one of three things: a missing integration, an unproven pipeline, or a stakeholder who isn't convinced yet.

  • Build the first of its kind: the demo that shows a studio head or a Fortune 100 CMO something nobody has shown them before. Working proofs of concept on the customer's own brand, footage, or catalog, often built in a day or two before the meeting, and the best of them become product for everyone.

  • Make it reusable: turn the one-off that unblocked one customer into the workflow, plugin, or integration the next ten customers start from.

  • Run the evaluation: own evaluation plans end to end, guide managed trials, build tailored demos on the customer's own footage and brand, and carry the technical side of deal cycles with AEs.

  • Scope deployments that land: 4–12 week engagements with customer-defined success criteria, a hands-on builder and an executive sponsor on their side from day one, and enough discipline to keep them on scope when the asks start piling up.

  • Get customers to production fast: take new technical and non-technical customers from signed contract to first production call in days rather than quarters, grow API-only accounts into Platform + API, and fix the onboarding so the support tickets stop coming.

  • Present to anyone: walk an analyst through a pipeline in the morning and a studio head through a production plan in the afternoon.

  • Bring the field back to the product: embed with Product, Engineering, and Creative to turn what you saw at the customer into roadmap. Every repeat ask is a product requirement, not a patch.

  • Measure what the customer measures: time to production, usage before and after a project, what they shipped because you were there. We track our own numbers in Salesforce and the warehouse; you'll own yours.

What we value

  • People who aren't satisfied with surface-level answers and will go into the data, the code, and the room to find the real one

  • Low ego: the customer's outcome matters more than who gets the credit

  • Comfort with open-ended problems in unstructured environments, and the instinct to create structure instead of waiting for it

  • Builders who would rather prototype than debate, and who keep iterating with the customer until it actually works

  • Adaptive and introspective: willing to learn, guide, lead, and follow

What we need

  • You build things that run in production. Python or TypeScript, APIs, integrations, and data pipelines. Whether you write the code yourself or with coding agents, you can read it, debug it when it breaks, and explain line by line why it's built that way, including to a customer's engineering team. You've shipped something a customer actually ran: a workflow, an integration, a plugin, or an internal tool.

  • You've deployed AI or ML systems and integrations inside complex organizations and can point to the outcome, not just the delivery

  • You can hold a room of executives and a room of engineers, and translate between the two. Some of those rooms are at the customer, so expect some travel.

  • Nice to have: data tooling (SQL, BigQuery, Retool), or experience in media, entertainment, or advertising production

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

Working at Runway

Great things come from great teams. We’d love to hear from you.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. So regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply.

More about Runway

  • GWM-1

  • Gen-4.5

  • General World Models

  • Robotics SDK

  • Conversational Real-time Agents

  • Runway Studios

About the role

We’re looking for a Product Engineer to join our team and help us build cutting-edge, AI-powered video creation and collaboration tools. Rather than specialists, we’re seeking curiosity-driven engineers who are thoughtful problem solvers and thrive in fast-paced, high-ownership environments. Our engineering team is highly collaborative and works on a wide variety of exciting challenges, including developing new interfaces for AI content creation, building LLM-powered features and conversational experiences, and deploying cutting-edge computer vision and generative models to production.

A peek at our technical stack

The rich UI of our generative AI tools is powered by TypeScript and React with MediaBunny driving in-browser media and React Flow powering our node-based creative workflows. Our API endpoints for user and media management are written in TypeScript and Node.js and deployed as containerized services on AWS ECS Fargate. We leverage AI APIs to power advanced generative capabilities.

What you’ll do

  • Create rich multimedia interfaces using the cutting-edge of the latest AI video generation models Gen-4.5 and Aleph 2.0

  • Build end-to-end full-stack AI-powered product features — designing and developing both frontend experiences and backend systems, including authoring server-side processes and APIs that power our generative AI tools

  • Design and implement LLM-powered features and conversational interfaces

  • Partner with a world-class engineering team pushing the boundaries of creativity and content creation on the browser

  • Take on new challenges across the Frontend stack to implement product features for Runway’s machine learning-based generative AI tools

  • Improve the performance, reliability, and code quality of our codebases

What you’ll need

  • 5+ years of industry experience in a software engineering role, ideally full-stack focused

  • Demonstrated fluency in one or more programming languages, including but not limited to JavaScript/TypeScript

  • Experience building with third-party AI APIs (e.g., chatbots, LLM integrations)

  • Experience in architecting production-ready systems and familiarity with debugging and profiling tools

  • Ability to rapidly prototype solutions and iterate on them with tight product deadlines

  • Humility and open-mindedness; at Runway, we love to learn from one another

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

About the Role

Runway is looking for a Marketing Manager to help build and scale high-impact marketing programs across our creator, partner, sponsorship, and growth ecosystem.

This is a generalist marketing role for someone who can move fluidly between strategy and execution. Some immediate areas of focus include influencer creator partnerships, sponsorships, and partnership marketing.

The right person is commercially minded, highly organized, creative, and comfortable operating in ambiguity. We are looking for someone who can build repeatable programs, manage relationships, and execute campaigns to turn marketing ideas into measurable growth.

What You’ll Do

  • You will own and support marketing programs that help Runway reach priority audiences, grow demand, and deepen our presence among our target audiences.

  • In the near term, this will include managing creator and influencer partnerships including affiliates, evaluating sponsorship opportunities, and building co-marketing programs with customers, technology partners, model providers, vendors, and ecosystem partners.

  • You will work across the full program lifecycle: identifying opportunities, developing briefs, managing outreach, coordinating execution, tracking performance, and recommending what to scale, change, or stop.

  • You will partner closely with growth, creative, comms, events, PMM, sales, business development, legal, and finance to make sure programs are clear, on-brand, operationally sound, and connected to business outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • We’re looking for a marketing generalist with strong executional judgment and enough strategic range to work across multiple types of programs for a range of B2C and B2B audiences.

  • Experience managing creator partnerships with a clear view of how long-form content performs differently from short-form and other social channels.

  • 4+ years of experience building marketing campaigns, influencer, affiliate, or growth programs from 0 to 1.

  • Experience managing external relationships: creators, sponsors, agencies, freelancers or vendors.

  • Experience writing briefs, managing timelines, coordinating stakeholders, and translating broad goals into concrete plans.

  • Strong taste, communication skills, and judgment around brand, audience fit, creator quality, partner value, business impact, and operational tradeoffs.

  • You should be comfortable with ambiguity and able to build from scratch. This role requires someone who can create structure where it does not yet exist, but without slowing the team down with unnecessary process.

  • You should care about measurement and be able to connect marketing programs to outcomes such as subscriptions, ARR, and enterprise pipeline influence.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in AI, SaaS, subscription products.

  • Experience creating partner-facing materials such as briefs, sponsorship packages, or co-marketing materials.

  • Familiarity with Runway, AI video, creator communities, internet culture, and the broader creative technology ecosystem.

We’re building a tool that makes content creation easy and accessible for all types of creatives. Our users love it. Runway has an actively engaged and growing community of passionate artists and creators worldwide. And we’re growing our support team to ensure we can continue to provide delightful experiences for our users every day.

We're looking for creatives at heart that can pick up new tools fast, hold up under high ticket volume without losing quality and identify solutions vs. just clearing the queue. If that's you, read on!

  • Work through a high volume of inbound support tickets across Free, Standard, Pro and Unlimited plans with speed and accuracy
